response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), s AS (SELECT ordertypedist, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g), b AS (SELECT ordertypedist, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS baseline FROM s) SELECT ordertypedist, cnt AS behaviour_record_count, share, share - baseline AS share_above_baseline FROM b WHERE share > baseline ORDER BY share DESC

assumptions.assumption: Share is a fraction (count / total count across all mixes, 0–1), not a percentage. The baseline is the simple average of the per-mix shares, with the NULL-mix group counted as one mix. 'How far above' is the plain difference share - baseline.
